results.expectation: Discrete rough dry earth clods, granular powder and cohesive darker wet earth repair are distinguishable rather than brown palette alone.
results.image_grounded_evidence: Foreground loose reddish clods and powder in/under the sieve are rough and dry; the right bowl holds a cohesive darker paste with wet highlights, and a dense reddish filler occupies the relief fracture. Distinct morphology and cohesion are visible, beyond a brown palette.

results.expectation: Mortar/sieve/tray or equivalent visible processing connects raw earth to damp repair paste.
results.image_grounded_evidence: A mortar containing coarse crushed earth sits at lower left; the sieve and powder tray occupy the foreground; the paste bowl and the knife-filled break lie within the same workbench arrangement.

results.expectation: Flaked corner or remaining dry fracture, actual blade contact and an already filled wet seam remain jointly legible.
results.image_grounded_evidence: The old pale relief has a broken front-edge recess and neighboring cracks. The palette-knife blade touches the edge of the reddish filler; the filled area already bridges part of the broken boundary while pale fractured edges remain exposed. The exact agent-chosen corner position became a front-edge break, but the required causal structure of this test remains legible.

results.expectation: Rust-colored dusty transfer is attached to the apron textile surface with fabric still readable.
results.image_grounded_evidence: A rust-colored finger-and-palm transfer lies on the canvas apron front. Visible weave, seam/strap structure and cloth shading continue through and around the stain, establishing the textile carrier.

results.expectation: Wet earth smear is attached to the right thumb/working hand beside the knife grip.

The exact thumb placement is weaker than the baseline phrase, but the prewritten expectation allows the right thumb/working-hand owner and that ownership is visible.

results.expectation: Visible face proportions and dark chin-length bob with fine fringe broadly follow the supplied appearance reference, without claiming biometric identity.

results.image_grounded_evidence: The right hand at screen left grips the short palette knife; the left hand at screen right rests against the sound panel edge. Both wrists/forearms lead back to the same woman, and the relief is supported by padding and a wooden board.

results.expectation: The inhabited indoor repair situation and focused tentative relief are readable from pixels without an invented biography.

A softened brow and parted lips permit a calm reading, but a specific transition into tentative relief is not distinct from ordinary concentration. That partial emotional realization is recorded as fail rather than promoted to pass.
